name: CircuitSymbols
status: Experimental prototype; not validated on external textbook or paper schematics.
runtime: Core ML and Vision; no Apple Intelligence or FoundationModels dependency.

training.dataSource: Synthetic images rendered from Circuit Studio native vector symbols. Randomized themes, rotations, flips, scales, labels, pin stubs and connecting wires. Templates are a separate holdout.
training.dataProvenance: Original project symbols and renderer (MIT project license); no external textbook images used. The pretrained objectPrint base is provided by Apple Create ML.

syntheticTest.dataScope: Synthetic native symbols; does not measure textbook/paper generalization.

nativeTemplates.dataScope: Synthetic native symbols; does not measure textbook/paper generalization.

evaluation.latencyScope: Inference only on the development Mac, including first inference. Does not include OCR or image preparation. Phone latency, peak memory, and energy use have not been measured.

intendedUse: Offline read-only candidate symbol boxes for clear cropped circuit schematics. OCR is a separate Vision request, not part of this model.
limitations: No wire topology or junction/crossing reconstruction.
No inferred pin roles, polarity, orientation or component-value associations.
No conversion into an editable circuit or simulation-ready netlist.
Confidence values are not calibrated probabilities of correctness.
Synthetic evaluation does not establish accuracy for textbooks, papers, photos or hand drawings.
External drawing conventions may differ; expect false detections and missed symbols.
reproduce: See README.md and scripts/circuit_vision.py for dataset, training and evaluation commands.
